identity.name: Physical Therapy in Sport
identity.source_note: Live current guide retrieved via Apify rag-web-browser headless render (WebFetch returned HTTP 403 ScienceDirect bot-block); full clean current guide obtained (HTTP 200). Official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports and Exercise Medicine (ACPSM). URL: https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/physical-therapy-in-sport/publish/guide-for-authors

encoding_notes: Reference style = APA 7th (Publication Manual, 7th Edition, 2020), an author-date system; mapped to 'custom' because APA is not in the style enum. in_text='paren' (Author, Year); reference list arranged alphabetically then chronologically; full (unabbreviated) journal titles per APA; DOIs encouraged/included.

Article types: Original Research and Review Papers each 'will not normally exceed 4000 words'. Case Studies (case_report) have NO stated word limit. Systematic Reviews & Meta-Analyses are accepted (dedicated submission section requiring PROSPERO registration + PRISMA 2020 checklist + flow diagram) but no distinct word cap is stated.

Masterclasses OMITTED from article_types: usually commissioned expert pieces (submitted as 'Feature Article'); no clean enum slot. Also omitted: book reviews and occasional conference reports mentioned in aims/scope.

Word-count rule (schema can't hold): the 4000-word counts INCLUDE keywords and in-text references, but EXCLUDE the end reference list, abstract, figures/tables, title/author information, and appendices.

abstract.structured=false: guide requires a concise factual abstract <=200 words; a 'Structured abstract' section is described (via appropriate headings) but is not clearly mandated for the primary type and prescribes no fixed section labels, so sections=null.
Keywords: 3-4 required, English, avoid multi-word keywords; case and separator not specified.
Highlights REQUIRED at submission: 3-5 bullet points, each max 85 characters incl. spaces, submitted as a separate file with 'highlights' in the filename (captured only as highlights_required=true).
Layout: double-spaced; margins 'at least 3cm' encoded as 30mm all sides; all pages numbered consecutively beginning with the title (position unspecified).
line_numbers='per_page' from 'Include line counts on each page to facilitate the review process' — phrasing is ambiguous; continuous numbering would also satisfy the reviewer intent.

Headings: 3-level scheme encoded. L1 major = capitals (centred + underlined), L2 secondary = sentence case (left margin + underlined), L3 minor = lowercase + italic. Schema cannot represent underlining or centre/left alignment of headings.

sections={} left empty: guide gives only an illustrative 'essential elements ... for example: Abstract, Keywords, Introduction, Materials and Methods, Results, Conclusions, Artwork and Tables with Captions' — hedged with 'for example', not a strict prescribed per-type order.

Tables placement: guide permits 'next to the relevant text or on a separate page(s) at the end'; the 'Presentation of manuscripts' section lists Tables/Illustrations/Figures as an end section each beginning on a new page, so encoded grouped_end. Table caption position not explicitly stated (notes go below the table body).

Figures supplied as separate files; formats TIFF/JPG/PNG (halftones & line drawings), EPS/PDF (vector). DPI is TIERED: 300 dpi color/grayscale photographs, 1000 dpi bitmapped line drawings, 500 dpi line/halftone combinations; schema holds one value so min_dpi=300 (baseline). Figure callouts use 'Fig.'; naming e.g. Figure_1, Figure_2.

scrub_metadata=false (conservative, matching sibling Elsevier encodings): double-anonymized review requires the manuscript and supplementary materials to contain no identifying info (names/affiliations/acknowledgements), but the guide is silent on scrubbing document/file metadata specifically.

declarations.order=[] (no formatting order prescribed). declarations.required: funding + conflict_of_interest (declarations tool always completed) + author_contributions (CRediT required) are unconditional; ethics_approval, patient_consent, and trial_registration are required conditionally (human/animal studies; identifiable-participant/case-report consent; registered clinical trials). Generative-AI-use disclosure, if any, goes in a new section immediately before the reference list.

cover_letter_required=false overall; a cover letter is referenced only for Systematic Reviews/Meta-Analyses (should justify novelty vs prior reviews). orcid_required=false (ORCID not mentioned in the guide). Peer review is double-anonymized; minimum two reviewers.
Source: live ScienceDirect guide via Apify headless render (WebFetch 403'd).
[schema-required default] figures.legends_location defaulted to 'in_text' (guide silent; legends left where authored).
